theme_archetype.name: Retro-Futurism / Swiss High-Contrast (Developer Tools)
theme_archetype.rationale: For DevOps and DevSecOps engineers, the interface must feel like a high-stakes command center or terminal, not a generic SaaS app. Objective, functional, and deeply technical.

typography.instructions: Import via Google Fonts in index.css: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;700&family=Outfit:wght@300;500;700;900&display=swap'); Apply fonts via Tailwind config or inline classes.

surfaces_and_micro_themes.cards: Cardless or flat surfaces. Use bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800 rounded-sm. No soft shadows.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.header: Solid dark background bg-zinc-950 with a strict border-b border-zinc-800. No glassmorphism.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.buttons: Sharp edges (rounded-sm). Primary: bg-green-500 text-zinc-950 hover:bg-green-400 font-bold. Ghost/Secondary: border border-zinc-700 hover:border-green-500 hover:text-green-400.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.grid_borders: For the interview room and feedback dashboard, expose the grid skeleton. Use border-collapse style layouts with border-r border-b border-zinc-800.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Dense but highly structured. Every pixel is utilized for data correlation.
spacing_and_layout.containers: Padding must be internal (p-6 or p-8) to prevent text collision on bordered elements.
spacing_and_layout.grid_mode: Use 'The Control Room' Grid (Mode B). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-4 or seamless gap-0 if using grid borders.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Hard state changes. ALWAYS explicitly set hover text color (e.g., hover:bg-zinc-800 hover:text-zinc-100).
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Fast and snappy. Use transition-colors duration-150.
motion_and_interactions.special_effects: Blinking cursor (animate-pulse) for active terminal inputs. Glowing text shadow on active timer.

component_instructions.icons: Install and use react-icons for tech stacks (SiAmazonaws, SiKubernetes, SiTerraform, SiDocker). Use lucide-react for standard UI icons.
component_instructions.forms: Customize Shadcn components. Strip out Vercel-look. Apply bg-zinc-900 border-zinc-800 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-green-500 rounded-sm font-mono.
component_instructions.charts: Use Recharts. Style with neon green/blue lines on fully transparent backgrounds. No default tooltips; match the dark terminal theme.
component_instructions.accessibility: MUST include data-testid on all interactive and key informational elements (buttons, inputs, timers, scores, history rows). e.g., data-testid="start-interview-btn".

landing_page.layout: Asymmetric Bento Grid (Mode A) for features.
landing_page.visuals: Hero uses the code matrix image with heavy bg-zinc-950/80 overlay. Do not hide the image completely. Headline left-aligned, massive.

setup_page.layout: Control room panel. 3-column grid for tech stack selection. Logo + Monospace Label.
setup_page.interaction: Selected tech tile gets a 1px green border and a green 'SELECTED' terminal label.

live_interview_room.layout: Split layout. Left pane (70%): Chat/Voice feed styled like a terminal stdout. Right pane (30%): Command Center (Timer, Question counter, Real-time score, progress bar).
live_interview_room.chat_interface: Do NOT use standard chat bubbles. Use log-style feeds. `root@ai:~# [Question text]` and `user@candidate:~# [Answer text]`.
live_interview_room.timer: Massive monospace numbers. Shift color to text-red-500 when under 10 minutes.

feedback_report.layout: Data-heavy dashboard. Top row: Score cards. Middle row: Mastery radar chart. Bottom: Log of all Q&A with diff-style syntax highlighting (green for correct, red for missing).
feedback_report.data_viz: Strict, objective color coding. Green = Strong, Amber = Needs work, Red = Critical.

history_dashboard.layout: Dense log-style table for past sessions. Columns for Date, Topic, Difficulty, Score. Visual sparklines for trend visualization.

hero_background.description: Code matrix on monitor. Use in Hero section with heavy dark overlay (bg-zinc-950/80).

server_texture.description: Modern server rack. Use as subtle texture for secondary sections (e.g., inside bento grid cards).
